大都會人壽投資管理槓桿融資業務負責人 John Jovanovic 分析，市場問題不在於短期信用惡化，而是未來仍有巨大債務供給湧入，發行方持續提高利息借貸會使既有債券承壓，促使投資人選擇觀望。
高盛策略師 Amanda Lynam 的統計顯示，今年美股市場發行用於 AI 與資料中心建設的公司債已達 1,060 億美元，幾乎是前一年總額的三倍。另一方面，CoreWeave 共同創辦人 Brannin McBee 與黑石集團均提到，取得「投資級」信評將是打開龐大保險資金池並顯著降低融資成本的關鍵。
paras_en: As the AI compute race heats up, financing costs for overseas AI infrastructure are soaring. Even top AI firms that have announced adjusted earnings must pay hefty risk premiums to secure the capital needed to expand compute capacity.

According to the Financial Times and other media, AI startup Anthropic is pushing forward a $60 billion chip financing deal called Project North Star, aimed at leasing about 1.5 GW of Google Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). The financing includes $42 billion of senior secured notes guaranteed by Broadcom and $18 billion of junior notes.

Private‑equity giant Blackstone plans to subscribe to $9 billion of the junior notes, with a coupon as high as 10%. When accounting for issuance discounts and fees, the effective yield will be even higher.

These figures highlight a striking shift in the AI financing market. Just four months earlier, in the “Big Sky” deal, Anthropic’s junior notes carried an 8.5% rate. Compared with the ICE Bank of America BB‑rated high‑yield index at roughly 7%, Anthropic’s borrowing cost is more than 300 basis points above the market benchmark.
Rating agency KBRA gave Anthropic a BB+ rating, one notch below investment grade, while the three major global rating agencies have yet to assign an official investment‑grade rating.

Although Anthropic disclosed Q3 2026 revenue of $16.8 billion and adjusted profitability, its long‑term compute and infrastructure procurement commitments exceed $500 billion. The gap between profit signals and massive long‑term cash obligations is the main reason the market demands a high return.

Rothschild & Co managing partner Robert Leitao commented that such off‑balance‑sheet financing structures essentially place a “highly concentrated bet” on the company’s future earnings capacity and must be backed by strong profitability to sustain the overall structure.

John Jovanovic, head of leveraged‑finance at Metropolitan Life Investment Management, analyzed that the market’s issue is not short‑term credit deterioration but the continued influx of huge debt supply; issuers raising interest rates will pressure existing bonds and push investors toward a wait‑and‑see stance.

Goldman Sachs strategist Amanda Lynam’s data show that U.S. corporate bonds issued this year for AI and data‑center construction have reached $106 billion, nearly three times last year’s total. Meanwhile, CoreWeave co‑founder Brannin McBee and Blackstone both noted that attaining an investment‑grade rating will be key to unlocking large insurance capital pools and significantly lowering financing costs.

items.title: 百名經濟學家全押12月升息！Fed本月料先按兵不動
items.title_en: One Hundred Economists All Bet on a December Rate Hike! Fed Expected to Hold Steady This Month
paras: 聯準會(Fed)本月料暫停升息，但年底前仍將再度收緊政策。《路透》周二(20日)公布最新調查顯示，100名受訪經濟學家中，94人預期Fed將在10月27至28日會議維持利率不變，全部受訪者則預期12月升息，與上月不到半數持此看法形成鮮明對比。
儘管經濟強勁、通膨高於預期，Fed官員近期仍傾向以較緩慢、審慎的步調調整利率。主席華許已表明不熱衷提供政策指引，對下一步動向保持沉默。
這項10月16至20日進行的調查顯示，多數經濟學家預期，Fed本月將維持聯邦資金利率區間在3.75%至4%，與市場定價一致。此次會議距離11月期中選舉僅剩數日；Fed上月才一致通過升息1碼。

暫停升息預期升溫 債市隨政策訊號震盪

瑞穗證券美國資深經濟學家Alex Pelle表示，經濟強勁且通膨居高不下，理應支持升息，但Fed目前僅勉強應對，甚至可能落後情勢。他認為，10月不升息是錯誤決策，12月雖料升息1碼，但升息2碼的風險高於完全不升息。
市場與經濟學家目前更追隨官員訊息，而非經濟數據。通膨與短期升息預期曾推動長天期美債殖利率於10月7日升至數十年高點，但隨10月升息可能性消退，殖利率又回落近25個基點；對政策敏感的2年期殖利率也先升後急跌。
在回答利率峰值問題的92人中，近六成預期利率將止步於4%至4.25%；另有38人預期至少還須升息兩次，占比高於上月的約兩成。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)美國首席經濟學家Michael Gapen表示，經濟與通膨風險偏向上行，Fed最終升息幅度可能超過預期。

通膨恐至2028年才達標 AI投資支撐經濟

美國通膨高於Fed的2%目標已近六年。調查預估中位數顯示，Fed偏好的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數年增率，未來幾季仍將高於3%，至少要到2028年才可能回到目標。
美伊戰爭推升能源成本，加上進口商品新關稅，生活成本上漲已成共和黨期中選舉前的一大政治弱點。戰事未見緩和，油價仍維持每桶100美元以上。
另一方面，AI投資支撐經濟韌性。美國第二季經濟成長年率為2.2%，第三季預估加速至3.2%，第四季則放緩至2.2%。全年成長率今年料為2.3%、明年為2.1%，均高於Fed認為不致推升通膨的2%水準。
瑞銀經濟學家Abigail Watt指出，AI科技建設帶動經濟韌性，但消費支出的支撐可能較集中於高所得族群，這些家庭透過股市受惠於AI熱潮的外溢效應。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve is expected to pause rate hikes this month, but will tighten policy again before year‑end. Reuters released a new survey on Tuesday the 20th showing that of 100 economists surveyed, 94 expect the Fed to keep rates unchanged at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting, while all respondents anticipate a rate hike in December, a sharp contrast to last month when fewer than half held that view.

Despite a strong economy and inflation above expectations, Fed officials have recently leaned toward a slower, more cautious pace of rate adjustments. Chair Jerome Powell has signaled a reluctance to provide forward guidance and remains silent on the next move.

The survey conducted Oct. 16‑20 shows most economists expect the Fed to keep the federal funds rate in the 3.75%‑4% range this month, in line with market pricing. The meeting comes just days before the November midterm elections; the Fed had unanimously approved a one‑basis‑point hike last month.

Pause‑rate‑hike expectations are warming, sending the bond market rippling with policy signals. Alex Pelle, senior U.S. economist at Mizuho Securities, said that a strong economy and high inflation should support hikes, but the Fed is only barely keeping up and may even lag behind. He believes skipping a hike in October would be a mistake; although a one‑basis‑point hike in December is expected, the risk of a two‑basis‑point hike is higher than doing nothing.

Markets and economists are now following officials’ signals more than economic data. Inflation and short‑term hike expectations had pushed long‑term U.S. Treasury yields to multi‑decade highs on Oct. 7, but as the likelihood of an October hike faded, yields fell back about 25 basis points; the policy‑sensitive two‑year yield also rose then plunged sharply.
Among the 92 respondents asked about the peak rate, nearly 60% expect it to cap between 4% and 4.25%, while 38 anticipate at least two more hikes, a share up from roughly 20% a month earlier.
Morgan Stanley U.S. chief economist Michael Gapen said that upside risks to the economy and inflation suggest the Fed’s eventual tightening could exceed expectations.

Inflation may not hit the Fed’s 2% target until 2028, with AI investment bolstering the economy. U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s 2% goal for almost six years. The survey’s median forecast shows the Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index will stay above 3% for several quarters, likely not returning to target until 2028.

The U.S.–Iran conflict is pushing energy costs higher, and new tariffs on imported goods are adding to living‑cost pressures, becoming a major political weakness for Republicans ahead of the midterms. With the war showing no signs of easing, oil remains above $100 a barrel.

On the other hand, AI investment is supporting economic resilience. U.S. Q2 growth was 2.2% annualised, Q3 is projected to accelerate to 3.2%, and Q4 to slow to 2.2%. Full‑year growth is forecast at 2.3% this year and 2.1% next year, both above the Fed’s 2% level it deems unlikely to fuel inflation.

UBS economist Abigail Watt noted that AI‑driven tech build‑out is enhancing economic resilience, but the boost to consumer spending may be concentrated among higher‑income households, which benefit from the spill‑over effects of the AI boom in the stock market.

items.title: 股價狂飆259%還被降評 戴爾AI營收翻倍為何不被買單？
items.title_en: Stock Soars 259% Yet Downgraded: Why Dell’s AI Revenue Doubling Isn’t Winning Buyers?
paras: 戴爾科技(DELL-US) 今年來股價累計飆漲259%，AI伺服器營收翻倍，卻遭巴克萊將評等由「加碼」下調至「中立」，目標價從603美元降至574美元。
巴克萊擔憂，營收高成長有相當一部分來自記憶體漲價推升售價，未來兩年恐面臨成長放緩風險。
戴爾2027會計年度第二季營收達469.7億美元，年增58%，創歷史新高，優於市場預期的約450億美元。調整後每股純益為7.04美元，較去年同期的2.32美元成長203%，也明顯超過市場預期的4.97美元。
負責伺服器、儲存及資料中心基礎設施的基礎架構解決方案集團（ISG），第二季營收達318億美元，年增89%，同樣刷新紀錄。
其中，AI優化伺服器營收達164億美元，年增約100%；傳統伺服器及網路業務營收105億美元，年增122%；儲存業務營收49億美元，成長26%。
涵蓋商用及消費型個人電腦的客戶解決方案集團（CSG），營收則達150億美元，年增20%。戴爾當季營業現金流為22億美元，並透過股利及股票回購，向股東返還創紀錄的43億美元。
全年展望上修 待交付訂單創高
隨著業績強勁成長，戴爾將2027會計年度營收預測上調250億美元至1,920億美元，相當於年增69%。管理層預估，全年依美國一般公認會計原則（GAAP）計算的稀釋每股純益為24.37美元，調整後每股純益為25.50美元。
第三季營收預估約490億美元，調整後每股純益約6.50美元。
戴爾揭露，AI伺服器待交付訂單已達創紀錄的950億美元，反映大型科技企業及資料中心業者對AI運算基礎設施的持續需求，也是支撐今年股價大漲的重要因素。
巴克萊示警 漲價放大營收成長
不過，巴克萊分析師Tim Long認為，市場可能高估戴爾營收成長的可持續性。即使目前營運表現強勁，估值偏高、記憶體成本上升，以及未來兩年成長可能減速，仍構成下調評等的理由。
巴克萊指出，戴爾2027會計年度展望意味著企業伺服器業務營收將成長逾100%，儲存及個人電腦業務也可望成長約15%，但其中相當一部分可能來自記憶體漲價帶動產品平均售價（ASP）提高，而非實際需求同步擴張。
記憶體是伺服器與個人電腦的重要成本。隨著AI產業對記憶體晶片的需求增加，零組件漲價往往會推升整機售價，進而拉高製造商營收。
然而，營收增加不代表出貨量或獲利以同樣速度成長。若成本同步攀升，廠商又無法完全轉嫁，毛利率仍可能受到擠壓。
記憶體價格回落 成長恐減速
巴克萊尤其擔憂，目前偏高的記憶體價格難以長期維持。一旦未來兩年價格恢復正常，甚至下跌，戴爾伺服器與個人電腦的平均售價可能隨之回落，使營收成長明顯放緩。
這意味著，即使AI伺服器出貨需求維持強勁，戴爾也未必能延續目前的高速成長。巴克萊認為，公司必須證明AI伺服器業務擴張能持續改善獲利率，而不只是反映記憶體成本上升。
股價大漲後 獲利能力成焦點
戴爾股價今年來累計上漲259%，但10月14日單日重挫逾11%，收在507.93美元。隨著估值攀升，市場關注焦點也從AI訂單規模，轉向訂單實際能貢獻多少獲利。
巴克萊調降後的574美元目標價，較10月14日收盤價仍有約13%的上漲空間，但該行認為，考量估值、成本壓力及成長減速風險，維持「加碼」評等的理由已不充分。
在待交付訂單與全年營收展望雙雙攀高之際，投資人對戴爾的要求也隨之提高。營收成長究竟來自需求擴張，還是零組件漲價，以及最終能轉化為多少獲利，正成為市場重新檢視其AI伺服器業務的關鍵。
paras_en: Dell Technologies (DELL-US) has seen its stock climb 259% year‑to‑date, with AI server revenue doubling, but Barclays cut its rating from "Overweight" to "Neutral" and lowered the target price from $603 to $574.
Barclays worries that a sizable portion of the high revenue growth comes from memory price hikes that lifted selling prices, and that growth could slow over the next two years.

Dell’s fiscal 2027 second‑quarter revenue reached $46.97 billion, up 58% year‑over‑year and setting a record, beating market expectations of about $45 billion. Adjusted earnings per share were $7.04, up 203% from $2.32 a year earlier and well above the market’s $4.97 estimate.
The Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG), which handles servers, storage and data‑center infrastructure, posted second‑quarter revenue of $31.8 billion, up 89% year‑over‑year, also a record.
Within ISG, AI‑optimized server revenue hit $16.4 billion, up roughly 100%; traditional server and networking revenue was $10.5 billion, up 122%; and storage revenue was $4.9 billion, up 26%.

The Client Solutions Group (CSG), covering commercial and consumer PCs, generated $15 billion in revenue, up 20%. Dell’s operating cash flow for the quarter was $2.2 billion, and through dividends and share buybacks it returned a record $4.3 billion to shareholders.
Full‑year outlook raised as order backlog hits record

With strong earnings growth, Dell lifted its fiscal 2027 revenue forecast by $25 billion to $192 billion, implying a 69% year‑over‑year increase. Management expects full‑year diluted GAAP earnings per share of $24.37 and adjusted earnings per share of $25.50.
Third‑quarter revenue is projected at about $49 billion, with adjusted earnings per share around $6.50.

Dell disclosed that AI server orders pending delivery have reached a record $95 billion, reflecting continued demand from large tech firms and data‑center operators for AI compute infrastructure and underpinning this year’s stock surge.
Barclays warns price hikes are inflating revenue growth

However, Barclays analyst Tim Long believes the market may be overestimating the sustainability of Dell’s revenue growth. Even with strong current performance, high valuation, rising memory costs and a potential slowdown in growth over the next two years justify the rating downgrade.

Barclays notes that Dell’s fiscal 2027 outlook suggests enterprise server revenue will grow over 100% and storage and PC revenues about 15%, but a substantial part of that may stem from memory price‑driven increases in average selling price (ASP) rather than genuine demand expansion.
Memory is a major cost component for servers and PCs. As AI drives higher demand for memory chips, component price hikes tend to lift the overall system price, boosting manufacturers’ revenue.
Nevertheless, higher revenue does not necessarily mean shipments or profits rise at the same pace. If costs rise in tandem and manufacturers cannot fully pass them on, margins could be squeezed.
Memory price decline could curb growth

Barclays is especially concerned that current elevated memory prices are unlikely to be sustained. If prices normalize or fall over the next two years, the average selling price of Dell’s servers and PCs could drop, markedly slowing revenue growth.

This means that even if AI server shipment demand stays strong, Dell may not be able to maintain its current rapid growth. Barclays says the company must prove that AI server expansion can continuously improve profitability, not just reflect higher memory costs.
Profitability becomes the focus after the stock surge

Dell’s stock has risen 259% year‑to‑date, but on October 14 it fell more than 11% in a single day, closing at $507.93. As valuation climbs, market focus shifts from AI order size to how much profit those orders actually generate.

Barclays’ revised $574 target price still leaves about 13% upside from the October 14 close, but the firm believes the case for an "Overweight" rating is no longer compelling given valuation, cost pressures and growth‑slowdown risks.

As both the order backlog and full‑year revenue outlook climb, investors’ expectations for Dell rise as well. Whether revenue growth stems from genuine demand expansion or component price hikes, and how much of it translates into profit, is becoming the key lens through which the market re‑examines its AI server business.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉反彈又卡關！AI疑慮重燃、油價回升再添壓 主要指數開低
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Lower as AI Concerns Resurface and Oil Prices Rise, Main Indices Start Down
paras: 美股主要指數周二(20日)開低，AI概念股再度湧現賣壓，加上油價回升，壓抑市場風險偏好。南韓資料中心業者上市首日表現慘淡，重新引發投資人對AI支出熱潮能否延續的疑慮，拖累那斯達克指數走低，也讓前一交易日的反彈受挫。資金轉進美國公債避險，市場同時聚焦本周企業財報，尋找支撐後續行情的線索。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近150點或近0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近130點或0.5%，標普 500 指數跌0.1%，費城半導體指數跌1.3%，台積電ADR跌近0.2%。
AI投資熱潮能否延續的疑慮再起，拖累美股期指周二走低，前一波反彈受挫。南韓AI基礎設施業者Elice上市首日重挫32%，打擊市場風險偏好，資金轉進美國公債避險，即使油價攀升，美債殖利率仍下滑。
標普500期貨下跌0.4%，那斯達克100期貨下跌0.8%。AI雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)盤前跌4%，晶片股也重啟跌勢。美國10年期公債殖利率下滑5個基點至5.09%，美元跌0.2%；布蘭特原油一度突破每桶111美元，創5月以來新高，市場持續評估伊朗進一步攻擊荷姆茲海峽的風險。
Elice寫下南韓具一定規模企業最差上市首日表現，呼應澳洲Firmus Grid約兩周前放棄IPO引發的AI融資疑慮。壓力也蔓延至債市，軟銀集團周二信用風險升至近四年最高。
Cavendish分析師Roger Lee表示，市場對AI資料中心及基礎設施投資的擔憂已累積數日，投資人需要確認龐大資本支出能帶來回報，但目前仍難看見。
市場接下來將聚焦大型AI投資企業財報，尋找支出規模與成長速度能否延續的線索。SpaceX(SPCX-US)預計周二盤後公布業績，Meta(META-US)則於周三接棒。
避險情緒同步籠罩其他市場。MSCI亞洲指標觸及7月以來低點，南韓Kospi指數重挫3.7%；歐洲Stoxx 600指數跌0.8%，工業與礦業股領跌。
Belle Capital投資長Mathias Heim認為，市場已開始反映獲利成長放緩，企業不斷上修資本支出的敘事恐難重現。他預期，後續將進入消化調整期，AI支出受惠企業成長可能降溫，高槓桿的新興AI雲端業者則持續承壓。
《彭博》策略師則指出，基本面仍足以支持逢低買進，這波疑慮主要來自融資端，但投資人正重新調整持股與避險配置，轉向體質較佳的企業。

paras_en: U.S. major stock indices opened lower on Tuesday (the 20th), as AI‑related stocks faced renewed selling pressure and higher oil prices dampened market risk appetite. A South Korean data‑center company’s dismal debut reignited doubts about whether the AI spending boom can be sustained, pulling the Nasdaq down and curbing the rebound seen the previous session. Funds shifted into U.S. Treasury bonds for safety, while the market also focused on this week’s corporate earnings for clues to support future moves.

Just before the deadline, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up about 150 points, roughly 0.3%, the Nasdaq Composite fell about 130 points or 0.5%, the S&P 500 slipped 0.1%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 1.3%, and TSMC ADR was down nearly 0.2%.

Doubts about the durability of the AI investment boom resurfaced, dragging U.S. futures lower on Tuesday and stalling the prior rally. South Korea’s AI infrastructure firm Elice plunged 32% on its first day of trading, hurting market risk appetite and prompting a move into U.S. Treasury bonds for safety; even as oil prices rose, U.S. Treasury yields continued to fall.

S&P 500 futures fell 0.4% and Nasdaq‑100 futures slipped 0.8%. AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) was down 4% in pre‑market trading, and chip stocks resumed their decline. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield dropped five basis points to 5.09%, the dollar fell 0.2%, and Brent crude briefly broke above $111 a barrel, hitting a May‑high as markets kept assessing the risk of further Iranian attacks on the Hormuz Strait.

Elice recorded the worst first‑day performance for a South Korean company of a certain size, echoing concerns raised two weeks earlier when Australia’s Firmus Grid abandoned its IPO, sparking AI financing doubts. The pressure also spread to the bond market, with SoftBank Group’s credit risk rising to its highest level in nearly four years on Tuesday.

Cavendish analyst Roger Lee said market worries about AI data‑center and infrastructure spending have been building for several days; investors need to see that massive capex can generate returns, but that is still hard to spot at the moment.

The market will now focus on earnings from large AI‑investing companies to gauge whether spending levels and growth rates can be sustained. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) is expected to release results after the market closes on Tuesday, and Meta (META‑US) will follow on Wednesday.

Risk‑off sentiment also spread to other markets. The MSCI Asia index fell to its lowest level since July, South Korea’s Kospi dropped 3.7%, and Europe’s Stoxx 600 slipped 0.8%, led down by industrial and mining stocks.

Belle Capital’s chief investment officer Mathias Heim said the market is already reflecting slower profit growth, and the narrative of continuously increasing capex is unlikely to repeat. He expects a digestion phase ahead, with AI‑benefiting firms seeing cooler growth and highly leveraged emerging AI cloud players remaining under pressure.

Bloomberg strategists noted that fundamentals still support buying on dips; the current concerns stem mainly from financing issues, but investors are rebalancing holdings and hedges toward companies with stronger balance sheets.

As of about 9 p.m. Taipei time on Tuesday the 20th: Dow Jones up 36.48 points or 0.07% at 52,002.51; Nasdaq Composite down 123.86 points or 0.47% at 26,307.02; S&P 500 down 12.05 points or 0.16% at 7,678.68; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 178.24 points or 1.57% at 11,138.11; TSMC ADR down 0.61% to $417.73; 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield fell to 5.11%; NY light crude rose 1.25% to $99.77 a barrel; Brent crude up 0.87% to $110.50 a barrel; gold down 0.52% to $4,138.40 an ounce; dollar index slipped to 101.74. Highlighted stocks: Raytheon Technologies (RTX‑US) fell 1.62% in early trading to $188.99.

U.S. defense contractor Raytheon Technologies (RTX) was up 1% in pre‑market trading. The defense giant reported adjusted Q3 earnings of $2.26 per share on revenue of $24.97 billion, both beating LSEG analysts’ forecasts of $1.78 and $24.08 billion respectively.
General Motors (GM‑US) fell 5.69% in early trading to $78.04 per share.

General Motors was down about 5% pre‑market. Although its Q3 results beat analyst expectations and the company raised its free‑cash‑flow outlook while narrowing its 2026 full‑year guidance range, the stock still slipped. GM also announced a new $20 billion share‑repurchase program but gave no specific timing for the buybacks.
Apple (AAPL‑US) fell 0.77% in early trading to $340.58 per share.
Apple (AAPL‑US) was down roughly 1% pre‑market. Loop Capital cut its rating from “Buy” to “Hold,” citing slowing iPhone sales and a valuation that it considers too high, prompting analyst concerns.
Key economic data for today: none.

Wall Street commentary: Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) prime brokerage data shows hedge funds have been cutting tech‑stock positions at the fastest pace in at least a decade. As AI trading cools and tech stocks tumble globally, funds are accelerating de‑risking, with net leverage falling to a one‑year low, reflecting a more conservative stance.

According to a Goldman Sachs Global Banking & Markets report covering the five trading days through Oct. 15, the proportion of tech‑stock reductions by hedge funds hit the highest level since the firm began tracking the metric in 2016. Over the same period, overall trading activity also saw its steepest decline in nearly three months.

Goldman noted that hedge funds’ net selling of global equities reached a two‑standard‑deviation level compared with the past year’s fund‑flow distribution, indicating markedly elevated sell pressure. Tech stocks bore the brunt of net selling, with the total reduction in long‑short positions hitting a two‑month high; measured by dollar amount, semiconductor stocks were hit the hardest.

items.title: 降規版也搶翻！中國科技三巨頭傳下單逾300萬張輝達新卡 供貨仍存變數
items.title_en: Even the Restricted Version Is Flying Off Shelves! China’s Three Tech Giants Order Over 3 Million Nvidia New Cards, Supply Still Uncertain
paras: 中國科技大廠搶購輝達(NVDA-US)晶片的熱潮未因美國出口管制而退燒。《路透》周二(20日)引述知情人士報導，字節跳動、阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)與騰訊(TCEHY-US)(00700-HK)已合計訂購逾300萬張RTX PRO 5500顯示卡，按報價計算總值超過350億美元。不過，需求遠超生產規畫，輝達已告知客戶，無法保證全數交貨。
這款產品效能雖不及輝達頂尖AI晶片，卻符合美國出口規範，是中國買家仍能取得的高效能選項之一。龐大訂單凸顯，在先進晶片取得受限、AI運算需求持續攀升之際，中國業者正積極尋找替代方案。

三大科技巨頭搶貨 輝達供應難追需求

兩名知情人士表示，三家業者訂購的顯示卡每張報價約1.14萬美元，潛在訂單總值超過350億美元。由於實際供貨量仍不確定，這筆金額尚不能視為輝達可實現的營收。
消息人士指出，中國客戶訂單總量已超過600萬張，但輝達向合作夥伴透露，2027年全球最多可能只能生產300萬張。另一名人士表示，部分合作夥伴獲告知，最終可能僅能取得所需數量的5%至10%。
RTX PRO 5500原本是供專業電腦使用的工作站顯示卡，並非為大型資料中心叢集設計。相較之下，輝達採用Blackwell架構的B300資料中心晶片禁止銷往中國，Hopper架構的H200則須逐案審查，並受出口許可條件限制。
輝達執行長黃仁勳曾表示，出口限制已讓公司在中國AI資料中心晶片市場的占有率，從近乎壟斷降至幾乎為零。但這波採購顯示，效能較低、仍可合法供貨的產品，依然存在龐大商機。

高階晶片解禁期待落空 業者轉向推論用途

三名消息人士表示，中國企業採購RTX PRO 5500，主要用於AI推論，也就是讓訓練完成的模型產生聊天機器人回覆等內容。相較於以海量資料訓練模型，推論通常需要較少運算能力。
根據《路透》取得的產品規格，RTX PRO 5500效能與RTX 6000D相近。輝達去年中推出RTX 6000D時，同樣以降低效能的方式符合出口限制，但中國大型科技公司最初興趣不高，部分業者甚至未下單。
當時買家認為，產品價格相對其效能過高，也期待美國最終放行更強大的輝達處理器。如今限制持續、AI算力仍然短缺，解禁期待逐漸消退，使RTX PRO 5500成為更具吸引力的替代選擇。
美國管制也促使中國企業轉向本土供應商，北京則鼓勵採用國產晶片，華為尤其受惠。不過，中國晶片商仍難全面追上美國領先產品，部分原因是先進半導體製造所需的海外設備也受到限制。

產能優先投入Rubin 明年首季開始交貨

供應吃緊除了反映需求暴增，也與輝達的生產優先順序有關。兩名消息人士指出，從2027年起，輝達預計將其在台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)的大部分產能配置，投入面向大型資料中心的新一代Rubin平台，而非RTX PRO 5500等產品。
輝達已告知客戶，預計12月提供初期樣品，2027年第一季開始商業交貨。另一名消息人士透露，RTX 6000D目前已停產，在中國市場的價格則已翻倍，進一步凸顯供需失衡。
輝達發言人表示，自2022年出口管制上路以來，中國工作站晶片與顯示卡業者已出現「前所未有的成長」，美國企業則同時受到美方過時出口管制與中國進口限制影響。
字節跳動、阿里巴巴、騰訊及美中相關主管機關均未回應置評要求，台積電則不予置評。
paras_en: China’s major tech firms are still snapping up Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips despite U.S. export controls. Reuters reported on Tuesday (the 20th) that ByteDance, Alibaba (BABA-US) (09988-HK) and Tencent (TCEHY-US) (00700-HK) have collectively ordered more than 3 million RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards, valued at over $35 billion at quoted prices. However, demand far outstrips production plans, and Nvidia has told customers it cannot guarantee full delivery.

Although this product’s performance falls short of Nvidia’s top AI chips, it complies with U.S. export rules and is one of the high‑performance options still available to Chinese buyers. The massive order highlights that, as access to advanced chips is limited and AI compute demand keeps climbing, Chinese firms are actively seeking alternatives.

Two sources said the three companies are paying roughly $11,400 per card, pushing the potential order value past $35 billion. Because the actual supply amount remains uncertain, this figure cannot yet be counted as realizable revenue for Nvidia.

Sources noted that total orders from Chinese customers have exceeded 6 million cards, but Nvidia told partners that global production may top out at 3 million units by 2027. Another source added that some partners were warned they might ultimately receive only 5‑10% of the requested quantity.

The RTX PRO 5500 was originally designed as a workstation graphics card for professional PCs, not for large data‑center clusters. By contrast, Nvidia’s Blackwell‑based B300 data‑center chip is banned from sales to China, and the Hopper‑based H200 requires case‑by‑case review and export‑license restrictions.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has said export limits have reduced the company’s share of the Chinese AI data‑center chip market from near‑monopoly to almost zero. Yet this procurement shows that lower‑performance products that can still be shipped legally retain a huge business opportunity.

Three sources said Chinese firms are buying the RTX PRO 5500 mainly for AI inference – running trained models to generate chatbot replies and similar outputs. Inference typically needs far less compute than the massive data‑training phase.

According to product specifications obtained by Reuters, the RTX PRO 5500’s performance is close to that of the RTX 6000D. When Nvidia launched the RTX 6000D last year, it also reduced performance to meet export limits, but large Chinese tech companies were initially lukewarm and some did not place orders.

Buyers then thought the price was too high for the performance and hoped the U.S. would eventually clear more powerful Nvidia processors. With restrictions persisting and AI compute still scarce, hopes for a lift are fading, making the RTX PRO 5500 a more attractive substitute.

U.S. controls have also pushed Chinese firms toward domestic suppliers, with Beijing encouraging the use of home‑grown chips; Huawei in particular has benefited. Still, Chinese chip makers struggle to match leading U.S. products, partly because overseas equipment needed for advanced semiconductor manufacturing is also restricted.

Tight supply reflects not only a surge in demand but also Nvidia’s production priorities. Two sources said that from 2027 onward Nvidia plans to allocate most of its capacity at TSMC (2330-TW) (TSM-US) to its next‑generation Rubin platform for large data centers, rather than to products like the RTX PRO 5500.

Nvidia has told customers it expects to provide initial samples in December and begin commercial shipments in Q1 2027. Another source said the RTX 6000D has now been discontinued, and its price in China has doubled, underscoring the supply‑demand imbalance.

A Nvidia spokesperson said that since the 2022 export controls took effect, Chinese workstation chip and graphics‑card makers have seen “unprecedented growth,” while U.S. firms are simultaneously hampered by outdated U.S. export rules and Chinese import restrictions.
ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent and the relevant U.S. and Chinese regulators did not respond to comment requests, and TSMC declined to comment.

items.title: CoreWeave信貸風暴 為何華爾街將其比作「矽谷銀行」？
paras: 由輝達(NVDA-US)支持的美國新型雲端算力服務商(NeoCloud)CoreWeave(CRWV-US)，近期因高額債務與急速膨脹的資本支出，引爆市場對「AI泡沫破裂」的集體恐慌。
CoreWeave 股價單周重挫逾15%，其2031與2032年到期的無擔保債券殖利率更飆升至近16%的垃圾債水準，信用違約交換(CDS)利差突破1000個基點。
市場擔憂，這家背負350億至500億美元債務的算力巨頭若資金鏈斷裂，恐觸發跨越銀行體系的連鎖信貸風暴。
然而，巴克萊(Barclays)、高盛(Goldman Sachs)與摩根大通(JPMorgan)等華爾街巨頭一致澄清：這是一場類似2023年「矽谷銀行(SVB)」事件的局部過度恐慌，而非2008年金融危機重演。

華爾街將 CoreWeave風波比作SVB事件

華爾街將 CoreWeave 風波比作 SVB 事件，主因在於市場再次犯了「將局部脆弱資產過度外推至整體宏觀經濟」的推論錯誤：
「小尾巴搖動大狗」的外推謬誤： 巴克萊全球研究主席Ajay Rajadhyaksha指出，2023年SVB倒閉時，市場恐慌以為信貸收緊會引發全美衰退，但實體經濟最終安然無恙。
Rajadhyaksha分析，CoreWeave 當前陷入拋售的15億美元無擔保債券僅占其總債務極小一部分，更僅占全球AI總資本支出的4%至5%。市場將微小次級債券的拋售放大解讀為上兆美元AI投資周期的終結，正是重蹈SVB事件中「用極小工具外推整體經濟」的推論謬誤。
定價訊號錯置與債務結構誤讀： 高盛分析師Gabriela Borges與Maura Hagger強調，無擔保債券15%以上的殖利率無法反映真實融資成本。
CoreWeave 主力融資是透過特殊目的載體(SPV)進行資產支持的「延遲提款定期貸款」(DDTL)，直接以微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta(META-US)等頂級客戶的「照付不議」(Take-or-pay)長約與GPU進行抵押，實際新增融資成本僅約7.5%至10.5%。
摩根大通分析師Kian Abouhossein表示，全球商業銀行對其曝險管理得當且擔保充分，多數歐亞銀行曝險低於5億美元，風險完全可控。
單一企業槓桿問題而非需求倒退： Equity Armor Investments 投資組合經理Brian Stutland表示，CoreWeave 困境源於自身高槓桿模式，而非AI算力需求衰退。
瑞銀(UBS)投資長Mark Haefele與 StoneX 分析師Mark Palmer補充，目前GPU租賃需求與價格依然強勁，企業可透過續約調漲租金對衝成本上升。

華爾街觀點分歧：看多派 vs. 警戒派

看多派(投行與管理層)： 摩根大通股票分析師Samik Chatterjee給予 CoreWeave「增持」評級，指出其五年期合約的無槓桿內部報酬率(IRR)約15%，高於9%至11%的加權平均資本成本(WACC)，高現金消耗主因是擴張過快而非項目虧損。
CoreWeave 執行長Mike Intrator在備忘錄中強調市場過度反應，公司手握逾1000億美元待實現訂單，足以覆蓋債務。高盛將 CoreWeave 股票評級上調至「買入」。
警戒派(對沖基金與研究機構)： Marlborough 基金經理James Athey與 Andromeda Capital 創辦人Alberto Gallo提醒，CoreWeave 負債累累且預計至2030年前自由現金流持續為負，高槓桿極大化了營運風險。
Gartner 分析師與 Index & Cie 投資長Tommaso Leodari警告，完全靠債務支撐運營的新型雲端服務商最易受營收延遲衝擊，預估至2030年將有80%新興雲端業者停止獨立營運。

items.title: 美股多頭還能撐？財報與Fed成考驗 標普7500點是關鍵防線
items.title_en: Can US Bull Market Hold? Earnings and the Fed as Tests, 7,500 S&P Points a Key Defense Line
paras: 美股多頭走勢尚未遭到破壞，但AI概念股重挫、銀行股財報後表現疲弱，以及信用市場壓力升高，正讓投資人重新檢視年底行情。華爾街寄望企業財報與期中選舉過後的季節性助力，帶動市場回穩；多位策略師則將標普500指數7,500點視為重要支撐，若失守，可能意味這波跌勢不只是例行回檔。
《CNBC》分析指出，標普500過去半年回檔幅度均未超過3%，AI科技股與其他類股輪動，持續支撐大盤。不過，指數目前在趨於平坦的50日均線附近震盪，點位與11周前相去不遠，顯示上漲動能已放緩。

AI反彈未解疑慮 7,500點成觀察防線

上周稍晚，半導體、資料中心相關股票與債券出現急迫賣壓，交易節奏近似被迫平倉。周一半導體股雖初步反彈，避免賣壓進一步失序，仍不足以確認市場已站穩腳步。
摩根大通(JPM-US)技術策略師Jason Hunter指出，市場可能正接近類股輪番修正的尾聲，為年底漲勢鋪路；但市場內部、動能與不同資產間出現的多項背離，也可能預告更廣泛、同步的下跌。
他傾向審慎解讀，將距離當時指數約2.5%的7,500點視為關鍵。一旦跌破，就更難維持對後市的偏多判斷。
Macro Risk Advisors策略師John Kolovos也認為，AI交易退潮與金融環境收緊，正讓過度樂觀的情緒降溫，有助年底行情醞釀；但若跌破9月中旬約7,500點的低點，就須警惕跌勢超出一般回檔。

獲利成長逾兩成 仍須提防2018年前例

基本面並非全然悲觀。本季標普500企業獲利預估年增逾20%，歷史上期中選舉年的第四季也多有正面表現，均有利於多頭重新凝聚信心。
然而，2018年是值得留意的例外。當年同樣舉行期中選舉，企業全年獲利成長超過20%，標普500卻在第四季從高點至低點下跌約19%。此前市場已歷經動能股反轉，隨後也無力承受聯準會(Fed)進一步緊縮。
如今，美債殖利率上升、企業信用利差擴大、波動升溫與美元走強，也正在收緊金融環境。投資人雖認為市場已替Fed完成部分緊縮，但這些變化也有部分源自主席華許對抗通膨的決心，以及市場對後續升息的預期。
美國銀行(BAC-US)經濟學家Aditya Bhave仍預期Fed本月升息，但承認結果難料。摩根士丹利(MS-US)策略師威爾森(Mike Wilson)則認為，若華許承認金融環境已收緊，將有利於估值明顯下修的利率敏感類股；若漠視這些變化，可能勾起市場對2018年緊縮衝擊的記憶。

財報決定信心修復 市場緩衝逐漸減少

Ned Davis Research策略師Pat Tschosik表示，該公司的市場廣度指標已初步從超賣水準回升，但若大型科技公司第三季財報令人失望，仍可能引發更全面的賣壓，之後才有機會迎來選後反彈。
《CNBC》也提醒，投資人現金持有量相對融資餘額已降至低於2000年的水準。儘管避稅交易策略與現金存放方式改變，可能影響比較，這項數據仍反映市場曝險偏高、可動用買盤較少。
此外，企業股利與股票回購合計的股東收益率，已低於10年期美債殖利率。這並非立即看空訊號，卻意味投資人承擔股票風險時，需要更有說服力的報酬前景。財報能否兌現成長，以及Fed如何回應金融環境變化，將是年底多頭行情的重要考驗。
paras_en: US equity bulls have not yet been knocked down, but a sharp drop in AI‑related stocks, weak post‑earnings performance of banks, and rising pressure in credit markets are prompting investors to reassess the year‑end outlook. Wall Street hopes corporate earnings and seasonal support after the midterm elections will stead the market; several strategists see the S&P 500’s 7,500‑point level as a crucial support, and a break below could mean the decline is more than a routine pullback.

CNBC analysis notes that over the past six months the S&P 500’s pullbacks have never exceeded 3%, with AI tech stocks and other sectors rotating to keep the index buoyant. However, the index is now oscillating near a flattening 50‑day moving average, and its level is not far from where it stood 11 weeks ago, indicating that upward momentum has slowed.

AI rebound fails to allay doubts, 7,500 points become a watch‑point. Late last week, semiconductor and data‑center stocks and related bonds faced urgent selling pressure, with trading rhythms resembling forced liquidations. On Monday semiconductor shares bounced back modestly, enough to stave off further disorderly selling but insufficient to confirm the market has steadied.

JPMorgan (JPM‑US) technical strategist Jason Hunter said the market may be nearing the end of a sector‑by‑sector correction, paving the way for a year‑end rally; yet internal market divergences, momentum shifts and cross‑asset mismatches could foreshadow a broader, synchronized decline.
He leans toward a cautious reading, treating the 7,500‑point level—about 2.5% below the current index—as critical. A breach would make a bullish outlook for the near term much harder to sustain.

Macro Risk Advisors strategist John Kolovos also believes that the AI trade pullback and tightening financial conditions are cooling overly optimistic sentiment, which could help set the stage for year‑end moves; however, a slip below the mid‑September low of roughly 7,500 points would warrant warning of a drop beyond a normal pullback.

Fundamentals are not wholly bleak. This quarter S&P 500 companies are projected to grow earnings by more than 20% year‑over‑year, and historically the fourth quarter of midterm election years has often been positive, both of which could help bulls regain confidence.

Nevertheless, 2018 remains a noteworthy outlier. That year also held a midterm election, and companies posted over 20% annual earnings growth, yet the S&P 500 fell about 19% from its high to low in the fourth quarter. The market had already seen momentum‑driven stocks reverse and then struggled to absorb further Fed tightening.

Today, rising US Treasury yields, widening corporate credit spreads, heightened volatility and a stronger dollar are tightening financial conditions. Investors think the market has already priced in part of the Fed’s tightening, but these shifts also stem partly from Chair Powell’s resolve to fight inflation and market expectations of further rate hikes.

Bank of America (BAC‑US) economist Aditya Bhave still expects a Fed rate hike this month, though he admits the outcome is uncertain. Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) strategist Mike Wilson argues that if Powell acknowledges tighter financial conditions, rate‑sensitive stocks with markedly lower valuations could benefit; ignoring these changes might revive memories of the 2018 tightening shock.

Earnings will determine confidence restoration, and market buffers are gradually eroding. Ned Davis Research strategist Pat Tschosik says the firm’s market‑breadth indicator has begun to climb out of oversold territory, but a disappointing third‑quarter earnings report from large‑cap tech could trigger broader selling before a post‑election rebound becomes possible.

CNBC also warns that investors’ cash holdings relative to margin debt have fallen to levels not seen since 2000. Although tax‑loss harvesting strategies and cash‑placement methods may affect the comparison, the data still reflects elevated market exposure and a reduced pool of readily available buying power.

Moreover, the combined shareholder return from dividends and buybacks now sits below the 10‑year Treasury yield. This isn’t an immediate bearish signal, but it means investors need a more compelling return outlook to bear stock risk. Whether earnings deliver growth and how the Fed reacts to evolving financial conditions will be key tests for the year‑end bull market.

items.title: 〈財報〉200億美元庫藏股也救不了！通用汽車Q3報喜 股價仍一度摔7.5%
items.title_en: [Earnings] Even a $20 billion share buyback can't save it! GM Q3 beats expectations, stock still drops 7.5% at one point
paras: 通用汽車(GM-US)第三季獲利與營收優於預期，並宣布新的200億美元庫藏股計畫，仍難挽回投資人信心。公司收窄全年財測區間，未如市場期待上調獲利展望，加上執行長巴拉(Mary Barra)警告外部挑戰正加劇，股價周二(20日)盤中一度重挫7.5%，創2025年7月以來最大盤中跌幅。
截至美東時間上午9時35分，通用股價下跌5.3%，報78.37美元。市場關注焦點已從當季表現轉向第四季獲利放緩，以及成本與車價壓力是否拖累明年成長。

財報優於預期 全年獲利展望未能驚喜

通用第三季營收500.2億美元，調整後每股獲利3.70美元，優於LSEG調查預估的487億美元與3.63美元。歸屬股東淨利約33億美元，高於去年同期的13億美元；調整後息稅前利益為41億美元，其中北美業務貢獻36億美元。
公司將2026年調整後息稅前利益預估，由140億至160億美元收窄至145億至155億美元，中位數仍為150億美元。調整後每股獲利區間則由12至14美元，改為12.75至13.75美元，中位數13.25美元低於市場預期的13.41美元。
財務長Paul Jacobson表示，第四季表現將較第三季下滑，但面對年底新增通膨壓力，公司仍能維持全年財測，反映團隊執行力。
通用同時將全年汽車業務調整後自由現金流預估，由95億至115億美元提高至115億至125億美元。第三季汽車業務自由現金流成長40%至59億美元，支撐新一輪回購；200億美元計畫將分多年執行，尚未訂出完成期限。

成本與銷量雙重壓力 明年成長仍有條件

巴拉表示，外部逆風明確存在，部分甚至正在加劇。通用雖受惠於高價皮卡與休旅車需求，但美國、中國銷量均下滑，部分消費者也因價格負擔而被排除在新車市場之外。第三季中國業務獲利僅3,200萬美元，年減60%。
成本方面，通用預估今年原物料通膨負擔約20億美元，落在先前預估上緣，物流與DRAM晶片成本也上升。保固成本預計接近10億至15億美元區間上緣，未扣除抵銷措施的關稅成本則料接近25億至35億美元區間下緣。
Jacobson指出，車價相對持平，公司將評估明年消費者承受能力，再決定是否透過較大幅度漲價轉嫁成本。
通用將於今年稍晚推出新款Chevrolet Silverado與GMC Sierra皮卡，並規劃在多個主要車型級距導入油電混合動力。巴拉仍預期2027年表現優於今年，但前提是需求維持強勁，原物料、物流及其他近期成本壓力緩和。
巴克萊分析師Dan Levy認為，通用對2027年的措辭轉趨保守，可能意味獲利預估面臨下修，也使龐大庫藏股利多難以抵銷市場疑慮。
paras_en: General Motors (GM-US) posted third‑quarter profit and revenue that beat expectations and announced a new $20 billion share‑repurchase program, yet it failed to restore investor confidence. The company narrowed its full‑year outlook range but did not raise profit guidance as the market hoped, and CEO Mary Barra warned that external challenges are intensifying. The stock fell as much as 7.5% during Tuesday’s (the 20th) session, the biggest intraday drop since July 2025.

At 9:35 a.m. Eastern Time, GM shares were down 5.3% at $78.37. Market focus has shifted from the quarter’s performance to a slowdown in fourth‑quarter earnings and whether cost and pricing pressures will drag on growth next year.

Earnings beat expectations but full‑year profit outlook offers no surprise. GM’s Q3 revenue was $50.02 billion and adjusted earnings per share were $3.70, ahead of LSEG’s forecast of $48.7 billion and $3.63. Net income attributable to shareholders was about $3.3 billion, up from $1.3 billion a year earlier; adjusted EBITDA was $4.1 billion, with North America contributing $3.6 billion.

The company narrowed its 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance from $14‑$16 billion to $14.5‑$15.5 billion, with a median of $15 billion. Adjusted EPS guidance was trimmed from $12‑$14 to $12.75‑$13.75, with a median of $13.25, below the market’s $13.41 expectation.

Chief Financial Officer Paul Jacobson said fourth‑quarter performance will be weaker than the third, but despite added inflation pressure at year‑end, the company can still meet its full‑year outlook, reflecting the team’s execution capability.

GM also raised its full‑year adjusted free cash flow estimate for the automotive business from $9.5‑$11.5 billion to $11.5‑$12.5 billion. Q3 automotive free cash flow grew 40% to $5.9 billion, supporting the new buyback round; the $20 billion repurchase plan will be executed over several years with no set completion deadline.

Cost and volume pressures create conditions for growth next year. Barra said external headwinds are clear and, in some cases, worsening. While GM benefits from strong demand for high‑priced pickups and SUVs, sales in the United States and China both declined, and some consumers are priced out of the new‑car market. Q3 profit from the China business was only $32 million, a 60% year‑over‑year drop.

On the cost side, GM estimates this year’s raw‑material inflation burden at about $2 billion, at the high end of its prior range, with logistics and DRAM chip costs also rising. Warranty costs are expected near the top of the $1‑$1.5 billion band, and tariff costs, before any offset measures, are projected near the low end of the $2.5‑$3.5 billion range.
Jacobson noted that vehicle prices are relatively flat; the company will assess consumer affordability next year before deciding whether to pass costs on through larger price hikes.

GM will launch new Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra pickups later this year and plans to introduce hybrid powertrains across several key model segments. Barra still expects 2027 performance to exceed this year’s, provided demand stays strong and raw‑material, logistics and other near‑term cost pressures ease.
Barclays analyst Dan Levy said GM’s more cautious wording for 2027 may signal a profit‑forecast downgrade, making the massive share‑repurchase program less able to offset market concerns.

items.title: 殖利率5%仍難吸引買盤 花旗直指美債避險效果減弱
items.title_en: Yield at 5% Still Fails to Attract Buyers, Citi Says US Bond Hedging Effect Weakens
paras: 花旗澳洲執行長Mark Woodruff表示，美國公債作為投資組合避險工具的吸引力正逐漸減弱，主因供給增加、通膨居高不下，以及中性利率上升。
Woodruff指出，殖利率達 5% 的美國 10 年期公債，通常是平衡股票配置風險的理想工具，但當前消費者物價與利率攀升的市場環境，已削弱投資需求。
Woodruff 周二(20日)在雪梨出席花旗澳洲與紐西蘭投資論壇期間，接受《彭博電視》訪問時表示：「市場對避險商品的需求增加，但這一輪週期的情況有些不同。」
他說：「債市仍有一些問題需要處理。供給持續增加，中性利率也不斷上升，這些壓力使公債不像過去幾輪週期那樣，能輕易發揮避險作用。」
這番談話反映出，市場對美國公債等相對安全的政府債券在投資組合中所扮演角色的看法正在轉變。過去幾年，股債相關性上升，促使部分投資人考慮其他投資，包括避險基金、信用債與大宗商品。
9 月全球債市遭遇猛烈拋售，美國 10 年期公債殖利率觸及 2007 年以來最高水準，部分原因是能源成本居高不下，加劇通膨上行壓力。
他表示：「全球央行正面臨更高的中性利率。通膨一直相當頑強，我們必須確保通膨預期不會根深蒂固。」
paras_en: Citi Australia CEO Mark Woodruff said the appeal of U.S. Treasury bonds as a portfolio hedge is gradually diminishing, mainly due to increased supply, persistently high inflation, and rising neutral rates.

Woodruff noted that a 5% yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury is usually an ideal tool for balancing equity‑allocation risk, but the current environment of rising consumer prices and rates has weakened investment demand.

Speaking on Tuesday (the 20th) in Sydney at the Citi Australia and New Zealand Investment Forum, Woodruff told Bloomberg Television that “demand for safe‑haven assets is up, but this cycle is somewhat different.”

He added, “The bond market still has some issues to address. Supply keeps growing and neutral rates keep climbing, putting pressure on Treasuries so they no longer provide the easy hedge they did in previous cycles.”

His comments reflect a shifting view of the role that relatively safe government bonds like U.S. Treasuries play in portfolios. In recent years, higher equity‑bond correlation has led some investors to look at alternatives such as hedge funds, credit bonds and commodities.

In September, global bond markets suffered a sharp sell‑off, with the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield hitting its highest level since 2007, partly because energy costs remained high and added upward pressure on inflation.
He said, “Central banks worldwide are facing higher neutral rates. Inflation has been stubborn, and we must ensure inflation expectations do not become entrenched.”

items.title: 連盈利的AI巨頭都要付10%利息 AI要融資愈來愈難了？
items.title_en: Even Profitable AI Giants Must Pay 10% Interest: AI Financing Is Getting Harder
paras: 在人工智慧(AI)算力競賽持續升溫之際，海外 AI 基礎建設的融資成本正顯著攀升。即使是已宣布實現調整後盈利的頭部 AI 企業，也必須支付高額風險溢價以獲取擴充算力所需的資金。
據英國《金融時報》與相關外媒報導，AI 新創公司 Anthropic 正在推進名為「北極星計畫」(Project North Star)的 600 億美元晶片融資案，旨在租賃約 1.5GW 的 Google 張量處理器(TPU)算力。這筆融資包含由博通提供擔保的 420 億美元優先順位債，以及 180 億美元的次順位債。
其中，私募股權巨頭黑石集團擬認購 90 億美元次順位債，其票面利率高達 10%，若計入發行折價與各項費用，實際報酬率將更高。
這項數據凸顯了 AI 融資市場的顯著變化。僅在四個月前的「Big Sky」融資案中，Anthropic 發行次順位債的利率約為 8.5%。相較於 ICE 美銀 BB 級高收益債指數約 7% 的市場基準，Anthropic 開出的借貸成本高出逾 300 個基點。
信評機構 KBRA 雖給予其比投資級低一檔的 BB+ 評級，但三大國際評級機構尚未給出正式投資級評級。
儘管 Anthropic 揭露 2026 年第三季收入達 168 億美元並實現調整後盈利，但其長期的算力與基礎設施採購承諾已超過 5,000 億美元。盈利訊號與龐大長期現金負擔之間的落差，成為市場要求高報酬的主要原因。
對此，Rothschild & Co 管理合夥人 Robert Leitao 評論指出，此類表外融資結構實質上是對企業未來獲利能力下了「高度集中的押注」，必須依靠強勁的營利來支撐整體結構。
大都會人壽投資管理槓桿融資業務負責人 John Jovanovic 分析，市場問題不在於短期信用惡化，而是未來仍有巨大債務供給湧入，發行方持續提高利息借貸會使既有債券承壓，促使投資人選擇觀望。
高盛策略師 Amanda Lynam 的統計顯示，今年美股市場發行用於 AI 與資料中心建設的公司債已達 1,060 億美元，幾乎是前一年總額的三倍。另一方面，CoreWeave 共同創辦人 Brannin McBee 與黑石集團均提到，取得「投資級」信評將是打開龐大保險資金池並顯著降低融資成本的關鍵。
paras_en: As the AI compute race heats up, financing costs for overseas AI infrastructure are soaring. Even top AI firms that have announced adjusted earnings must pay hefty risk premiums to secure the capital needed to expand compute capacity.

According to the Financial Times and other media, AI startup Anthropic is pushing forward a $60 billion chip financing deal called Project North Star, aimed at leasing about 1.5 GW of Google Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). The financing includes $42 billion of senior secured notes guaranteed by Broadcom and $18 billion of junior notes.

Private‑equity giant Blackstone plans to subscribe to $9 billion of the junior notes, with a coupon as high as 10%. When accounting for issuance discounts and fees, the effective yield will be even higher.

These figures highlight a striking shift in the AI financing market. Just four months earlier, in the “Big Sky” deal, Anthropic’s junior notes carried an 8.5% rate. Compared with the ICE Bank of America BB‑rated high‑yield index at roughly 7%, Anthropic’s borrowing cost is more than 300 basis points above the market benchmark.
Rating agency KBRA gave Anthropic a BB+ rating, one notch below investment grade, while the three major global rating agencies have yet to assign an official investment‑grade rating.

Although Anthropic disclosed Q3 2026 revenue of $16.8 billion and adjusted profitability, its long‑term compute and infrastructure procurement commitments exceed $500 billion. The gap between profit signals and massive long‑term cash obligations is the main reason the market demands a high return.

Rothschild & Co managing partner Robert Leitao commented that such off‑balance‑sheet financing structures essentially place a “highly concentrated bet” on the company’s future earnings capacity and must be backed by strong profitability to sustain the overall structure.

John Jovanovic, head of leveraged‑finance at Metropolitan Life Investment Management, analyzed that the market’s issue is not short‑term credit deterioration but the continued influx of huge debt supply; issuers raising interest rates will pressure existing bonds and push investors toward a wait‑and‑see stance.

Goldman Sachs strategist Amanda Lynam’s data show that U.S. corporate bonds issued this year for AI and data‑center construction have reached $106 billion, nearly three times last year’s total. Meanwhile, CoreWeave co‑founder Brannin McBee and Blackstone both noted that attaining an investment‑grade rating will be key to unlocking large insurance capital pools and significantly lowering financing costs.

items.title: 百名經濟學家全押12月升息！Fed本月料先按兵不動
items.title_en: One Hundred Economists All Bet on a December Rate Hike! Fed Expected to Hold Steady This Month
paras: 聯準會(Fed)本月料暫停升息，但年底前仍將再度收緊政策。《路透》周二(20日)公布最新調查顯示，100名受訪經濟學家中，94人預期Fed將在10月27至28日會議維持利率不變，全部受訪者則預期12月升息，與上月不到半數持此看法形成鮮明對比。
儘管經濟強勁、通膨高於預期，Fed官員近期仍傾向以較緩慢、審慎的步調調整利率。主席華許已表明不熱衷提供政策指引，對下一步動向保持沉默。
這項10月16至20日進行的調查顯示，多數經濟學家預期，Fed本月將維持聯邦資金利率區間在3.75%至4%，與市場定價一致。此次會議距離11月期中選舉僅剩數日；Fed上月才一致通過升息1碼。

暫停升息預期升溫 債市隨政策訊號震盪

瑞穗證券美國資深經濟學家Alex Pelle表示，經濟強勁且通膨居高不下，理應支持升息，但Fed目前僅勉強應對，甚至可能落後情勢。他認為，10月不升息是錯誤決策，12月雖料升息1碼，但升息2碼的風險高於完全不升息。
市場與經濟學家目前更追隨官員訊息，而非經濟數據。通膨與短期升息預期曾推動長天期美債殖利率於10月7日升至數十年高點，但隨10月升息可能性消退，殖利率又回落近25個基點；對政策敏感的2年期殖利率也先升後急跌。
在回答利率峰值問題的92人中，近六成預期利率將止步於4%至4.25%；另有38人預期至少還須升息兩次，占比高於上月的約兩成。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)美國首席經濟學家Michael Gapen表示，經濟與通膨風險偏向上行，Fed最終升息幅度可能超過預期。

通膨恐至2028年才達標 AI投資支撐經濟

美國通膨高於Fed的2%目標已近六年。調查預估中位數顯示，Fed偏好的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數年增率，未來幾季仍將高於3%，至少要到2028年才可能回到目標。
美伊戰爭推升能源成本，加上進口商品新關稅，生活成本上漲已成共和黨期中選舉前的一大政治弱點。戰事未見緩和，油價仍維持每桶100美元以上。
另一方面，AI投資支撐經濟韌性。美國第二季經濟成長年率為2.2%，第三季預估加速至3.2%，第四季則放緩至2.2%。全年成長率今年料為2.3%、明年為2.1%，均高於Fed認為不致推升通膨的2%水準。
瑞銀經濟學家Abigail Watt指出，AI科技建設帶動經濟韌性，但消費支出的支撐可能較集中於高所得族群，這些家庭透過股市受惠於AI熱潮的外溢效應。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve is expected to pause rate hikes this month, but will tighten policy again before year‑end. Reuters released a new survey on Tuesday the 20th showing that of 100 economists surveyed, 94 expect the Fed to keep rates unchanged at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting, while all respondents anticipate a rate hike in December, a sharp contrast to last month when fewer than half held that view.

Despite a strong economy and inflation above expectations, Fed officials have recently leaned toward a slower, more cautious pace of rate adjustments. Chair Jerome Powell has signaled a reluctance to provide forward guidance and remains silent on the next move.

The survey conducted Oct. 16‑20 shows most economists expect the Fed to keep the federal funds rate in the 3.75%‑4% range this month, in line with market pricing. The meeting comes just days before the November midterm elections; the Fed had unanimously approved a one‑basis‑point hike last month.

Pause‑rate‑hike expectations are warming, sending the bond market rippling with policy signals. Alex Pelle, senior U.S. economist at Mizuho Securities, said that a strong economy and high inflation should support hikes, but the Fed is only barely keeping up and may even lag behind. He believes skipping a hike in October would be a mistake; although a one‑basis‑point hike in December is expected, the risk of a two‑basis‑point hike is higher than doing nothing.

Markets and economists are now following officials’ signals more than economic data. Inflation and short‑term hike expectations had pushed long‑term U.S. Treasury yields to multi‑decade highs on Oct. 7, but as the likelihood of an October hike faded, yields fell back about 25 basis points; the policy‑sensitive two‑year yield also rose then plunged sharply.
Among the 92 respondents asked about the peak rate, nearly 60% expect it to cap between 4% and 4.25%, while 38 anticipate at least two more hikes, a share up from roughly 20% a month earlier.
Morgan Stanley U.S. chief economist Michael Gapen said that upside risks to the economy and inflation suggest the Fed’s eventual tightening could exceed expectations.

Inflation may not hit the Fed’s 2% target until 2028, with AI investment bolstering the economy. U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s 2% goal for almost six years. The survey’s median forecast shows the Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index will stay above 3% for several quarters, likely not returning to target until 2028.

The U.S.–Iran conflict is pushing energy costs higher, and new tariffs on imported goods are adding to living‑cost pressures, becoming a major political weakness for Republicans ahead of the midterms. With the war showing no signs of easing, oil remains above $100 a barrel.

On the other hand, AI investment is supporting economic resilience. U.S. Q2 growth was 2.2% annualised, Q3 is projected to accelerate to 3.2%, and Q4 to slow to 2.2%. Full‑year growth is forecast at 2.3% this year and 2.1% next year, both above the Fed’s 2% level it deems unlikely to fuel inflation.

UBS economist Abigail Watt noted that AI‑driven tech build‑out is enhancing economic resilience, but the boost to consumer spending may be concentrated among higher‑income households, which benefit from the spill‑over effects of the AI boom in the stock market.

items.title_en: Foreign Investors Pull Out, Taiwan Stocks and Currency Both Plunge; TWD Briefly Drops 0.227 NTD, Losing the 32.6‑NTD Barrier
paras: 股匯雙殺再現，三大法人今(20)日合計賣超台股968.04億元，外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元終場收在32.617元，重貶1.72角，成交金額達32.77億美元；元太外匯市場成交金額為9.995億美元。兩大外匯市場今日成交金額合計高達 42.765 億美元，顯示在熱錢急退與避險結匯需求湧現下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
新台幣今日以32.48元開出，盤中最高32.48元，隨後受外資擴大匯出影響，一度衝破32.67元關卡，盤中下探至32.672元，最低重貶2.27角，全日維持弱勢重貶格局。
從國際盤與總體環境觀察，雖然美股科技族群昨日出現逢低買盤，帶動那斯達克與費城半導體指數反彈，但亞幣整體維持弱勢格局，直接加重了新台幣的走貶壓力。市場資金在區域資產間快速挪移，外資於台股及匯市同步進行提款操作，形成匯市盤中沉重的下行連動壓力。
在台股與籌碼面部分，根據臺灣證券交易所統計數據，台股今日受電子權值股走弱影響，終場下跌529.15點，收在46292.93點，成交金額為7586.84億元。三大法人今日合計賣超台股968.04億元，其中外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，自營商賣超355.79億元，僅投信逆勢買超183.15億元，顯示外資大舉提款並將資金轉匯出境，是引發今日股匯雙殺的核心因素。
觀察市場後續演變，匯銀人士與市場專家分析指出，新台幣短線能否止貶回穩，完全取決於美股財報週表現及外資提款動作是否放緩。目前新台幣匯率陷於32.6元拉鋸戰，若熱錢匯出趨勢短期內未能平息，匯市不排除進一步回測32.8元關卡。
paras_en: The double blow to stocks and the foreign exchange market reappeared today, with the three major institutional investors collectively selling NT$96.804 billion of Taiwan equities. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors accounted for a net sell of NT$79.54 billion. The Taipei FX market closed at NT$32.617 per US $, a depreciation of 0.172 NTD, with a turnover of US$3.277 billion; the Yuan‑Tai FX market saw a turnover of US$0.9995 billion. Combined, the two FX markets handled US$4.2765 billion, indicating unusually vigorous trading amid a rapid outflow of hot money and a surge in hedging demand.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$32.48 and peaked at NT$32.48 intraday. It then slipped as foreign investors accelerated outflows, briefly breaching the NT$32.67 barrier and falling to NT$32.672, a low that represented a 0.227 NTD weakening. The currency remained in a weak, depreciating stance throughout the session.

Looking at the international markets and the broader environment, U.S. tech stocks rallied yesterday, lifting the Nasdaq and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index. However, Asian currencies stayed weak overall, adding pressure to the TWD’s decline. Capital shifted quickly among regional assets, and foreign investors withdrew from both Taiwan equities and the FX market simultaneously, creating a heavy downward linkage in the currency market.

On the equity side, Taiwan Stock Exchange data show that the market was dragged down by weaker electronic‑sector leaders, closing down 529.15 points at 46,292.93 with a turnover of NT$758.684 billion. The three major institutional investors sold a total of NT$96.804 billion of stocks, of which foreign and mainland investors net‑sold NT$79.54 billion, proprietary traders sold NT$35.579 billion, while only mutual funds bought NT$18.315 billion against the trend. The large‑scale foreign outflow and capital repatriation were the core drivers of today’s stock‑FX double‑hit.

Looking ahead, FX analysts and market experts say the short‑term fate of the TWD hinges on U.S. earnings reports and whether foreign capital withdrawals ease. The TWD is currently locked in a tug‑of‑war around the NT$32.6 level; if hot‑money outflows persist, the market could test the NT$32.8 barrier further downwards.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 法國動亂與暴力抗議拖累歐元
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Strengthens as French Unrest and Violent Protests Drag Down Euro
paras: 美元周一(19日)走強，主要受到歐元下跌，以及美國債券市場再度出現拋售潮的推動。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報102。此前，美元指數出現近五週以來首次單週下跌，主要因市場對美國聯準會（Fed）短期內升息的預期略微降溫。
法國陷入動盪
美國及全球外匯市場的參與者，正密切關注法國局勢不斷升級的情況。
作為歐元區第二大經濟體，法國週末爆發大規模暴力抗議，民眾不滿生活成本飆升，以及公共服務經費不足。同時，法國本身也正面臨財政危機。
法國各城市有數千人與警方發生衝突，部分商店遭到洗劫，造成近年來最嚴重社會動亂之一。暴力事件進一步加大法國總統馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）政治壓力。在 2027 年任期結束前，他的施政已因日益高漲的社會不滿情緒而陷入愈發嚴重的停滯。
由於法國政府公債（OAT）表現落後，而透過信用違約交換（CDS）為法國主權債務投保的成本也升至多年高點，法國公債與德國聯邦公債（Bund）之間的利差進一步擴大，對歐元構成直接的基本面壓力。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.3%，至 1.1210 美元。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師 Thierry Wizman 表示，「法國的社會局勢可能帶來一種和平且具宣洩效果的改變，例如透過提高退休年齡來推動緊縮政策，前提是民主制度能夠維持穩定。然而，真正可能引發轉變的 2027 年大選，對大多數交易員而言仍太遙遠。他們更擔心的是未來幾週的局勢發展。」
他進一步指出，「只要電視畫面持續出現混亂景象，市場就傾向於賣出歐元，並推高法國主權債務利差。如果法國出現存款外流，將可能促使歐洲央行（ECB）介入，而這很可能進一步削弱歐元。」
法國 10 年期公債殖利率週一大幅上升，債券拋售壓力也蔓延至美國市場。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 4.5 個基點，來到 5.145%。對利率政策較為敏感的 2 年期公債殖利率則上升 4 個基點，來到 4.776%。
日元走弱 加幣走強
日元走弱，美元兌日元升至 158.53。
日本當局先前已與美國釋出聯合警告訊號，外匯交易部門對東京當局可能在目前價位進場干預匯市，仍保持高度警戒。
日本銀行（BoJ）總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在公開談話中表示，日本的基礎通膨正穩步接近央行設定的 2% 目標。
植田的發言進一步強化市場預期：央行仍將循序漸進地推動貨幣政策正常化。因此，利率市場持續關注日銀今年稍晚可能採取的貨幣政策調整。
另一方面，印尼盾終於停止連續四個交易日的跌勢。在這波下跌期間，印尼盾一度貶至 1 美元兌 18,063 印尼盾，創下近三個月來最低。
這波拋售潮起因是 MSCI 提議調降印尼股票市場評級，理由是印尼市場長期存在外資進入不易及公司治理方面的疑慮。
這項提議引發印尼雅加達綜合指數單日暴跌 11.6%，創下 1998 年亞洲金融風暴以來最大單日跌幅。
其他市場方面，加拿大幣兌美元走強，美元兌加拿大元跌至 1.4110。
加拿大消費者通膨加速，提升了市場對加拿大央行(BoC)可能採取較強硬貨幣政策的預期。
根據加拿大統計局公布數據，加拿大 9 月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率為 3.1%，低於經濟學家預估的 3.2%，但高於 8 月的 3.0%。
此外，這也是加拿大 CPI 連續三個月上升後，首次超出加拿大央行設定的 1% 至 3% 通膨目標區間。
本次 CPI 上升主要受到能源價格推動。能源價格年增 19%，其中汽油價格更大幅上漲 27.8%。
加拿大央行總裁 Tiff Macklem 已表示，通膨可能進一步上升。儘管他也指出，目前還沒有太多證據顯示，價格壓力已經擴散至其他商品與服務。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Monday (the 19th), mainly driven by a falling euro and a renewed wave of selling in the U.S. bond market.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 102. Earlier, the index had posted its first weekly decline in nearly five weeks, as expectations for near‑term Fed rate hikes cooled slightly.
France in Turmoil
Market participants in the U.S. and global FX markets are watching the escalating situation in France closely.

As the euro‑area’s second‑largest economy, France saw massive violent protests over the weekend, with citizens angry about soaring living costs and underfunded public services, while the country also faces a fiscal crisis.

Thousands clashed with police in cities across France, some shops were looted, creating one of the most severe social upheavals in recent years. The violence adds political pressure on President Emmanuel Macron, whose agenda is increasingly stalled by rising social discontent ahead of the end of his term in 2027.

Because French government bonds (OAT) have underperformed and the cost of insuring French sovereign debt via credit‑default swaps (CDS) has risen to multi‑year highs, the spread between French OATs and German Bunds has widened, putting direct fundamental pressure on the euro.
The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1210.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “France’s social situation could lead to a peaceful, venting‑type change, such as raising the retirement age to push a tightening agenda, provided the democratic system remains stable. However, the real catalyst – the 2027 election – is still too far away for most traders. They are more concerned about how the situation develops over the next few weeks.”

He added, “As long as TV screens keep showing chaos, markets tend to sell euros and push French sovereign spreads higher. If France sees capital outflows, the European Central Bank may step in, which could further weaken the euro.”
French 10‑year bond yields jumped sharply on Monday, and bond‑selling pressure spread to the U.S. market.
U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose 4.5 basis points to 5.145%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbed 4 basis points to 4.776%.
Yen Weakens, Canadian Dollar Strengthens
The yen weakened as the dollar rose to ¥158.53.
Japanese authorities have previously signaled a joint warning with the United States, and the FX trading desk remains on high alert for possible intervention by Tokyo officials at current levels.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said in a public remarks that Japan’s core inflation is steadily moving toward the central bank’s 2% target.
Ueda’s comments reinforced market expectations that the BOJ will continue a gradual normalization of monetary policy, keeping rate markets focused on potential policy adjustments later this year.
On the other hand, the Indonesian rupiah finally halted a four‑day losing streak. During the decline it had slipped to IDR 18,063 per dollar, a three‑month low.
The sell‑off was sparked by an MSCI proposal to downgrade Indonesia’s equity market rating, citing long‑standing difficulties for foreign investors and corporate‑governance concerns.
The proposal triggered an 11.6% single‑day plunge in the Jakarta Composite Index, the biggest daily drop since the 1998 Asian financial crisis.
In other markets, the Canadian dollar rose against the dollar, with USD/CAD slipping to 1.4110.
Canadian consumer inflation accelerated, raising expectations that the Bank of Canada may adopt a tighter policy stance.
Statistics Canada reported that September’s CPI rose 3.1% year‑over‑year, below the 3.2% forecast but above August’s 3.0%.
It also marked the first time in three months that Canada’s CPI moved above the BoC’s 1%‑3% target range.
The CPI increase was mainly driven by energy prices, which rose 19% year‑over‑year, with gasoline jumping 27.8%.
Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem said inflation could rise further, though he noted there is still limited evidence that price pressures have spread to other goods and services.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢持續流出 重貶1.07角收32.445元
items.title_en: TWD: Hot Money Continues to Flow Out, Depreciates 0.107 to Close at 32.445
paras: 台北金融市場今(19) 日「股匯雙殺」再現，受到美股震盪及國際避險情緒升溫影響，外資持續大舉撤資，三大法人合計賣超台股899.54億元，加權指數一度重挫941點，台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 等權值股尾盤急拉，終場下跌289.18點，收在46822.08點。匯市在資金大量淨匯出壓力下，新台幣兌美元匯率開低走低，盤中一度觸及32.572元低點，終場重貶1.07角收在32.445元，兩大外匯市場爆出38.53億美元的大量。
觀察台股法人動態，三大法人今日資金操作分歧明顯。外資及陸資延續偏空態度，單日賣超高達767.43億元，寫下連續9個交易日賣超紀錄；自營商也站在賣方，賣超362.63億元；僅投信法人獨撐大局，逆勢買超230.51億元，展現強烈護盤意願。
今日台股籌碼面持續出現調節，導致大盤開盤即遭重挫，盤中最低下探46170點，考驗季線支撐，所幸尾盤台積電等半導體族群拉回平盤，帶動指數跌幅收斂。
匯市方面，新台幣兌美元開盤價為32.36元，隨後受外資強勁匯出買賣盤衝擊，匯價一路下探，早盤最高僅達32.36元，盤中最低重摔至32.572元。面對外資短時間大幅撤離，中央銀行盤中罕見緊急發布聲明穩固信心，並適時進場拋匯提供美元流動性。終場台北外匯市場新台幣收在32.445元，貶值1.07角；成交金額則擴大至28.31億美元。
元太外匯市場新台幣收盤價則為32.468元，貶值1.2角，成交金額為10.22億美元。兩大匯市合計成交金額衝高至38.53億美元，顯示市場交投極為熱絡且多空對峙激烈。
paras_en: Taipei's financial markets saw a repeat of the "stock‑currency double kill" today (19th) as US equity volatility and rising global risk‑off sentiment prompted foreign investors to pull out large amounts of capital. The three major institutional investors collectively sold a net 89.954 billion TWD of Taiwanese equities, and the weighted index plunged as much as 941 points before ending down 289.18 points at 46,822.08. Meanwhile, under heavy net outflows in the foreign exchange market, the New Taiwan dollar weakened against the US dollar, briefly hitting a low of 32.572 TWD per USD before closing down 0.107 to 32.445, with the two major FX markets reporting a combined outflow of $3.853 billion.

Looking at the activity of Taiwan's institutional investors, today's fund flows showed a clear divergence. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors maintained a bearish stance, net selling a record 76.743 billion TWD in a single day, marking the ninth consecutive trading day of net outflows. Proprietary traders also sold, netting 36.263 billion TWD. Only investment trusts stood on the buying side, net purchasing 23.051 billion TWD, demonstrating a strong willingness to support the market.

The market's capital structure continued to adjust today, causing the index to tumble sharply at the open and dip to a intraday low of 46,170 points, testing the seasonal (quarterly) support line. Fortunately, semiconductor stocks such as TSMC rallied in the closing minutes, pulling the index back toward the flat line and narrowing the overall decline.

In the FX market, the TWD opened at 32.36 per USD but was quickly pressured lower by strong foreign outflows, falling to a low of 32.572 during the session. Facing a rapid, large‑scale withdrawal of foreign capital, the central bank issued a rare emergency statement mid‑session to steady confidence and intervened by selling dollars to provide liquidity. The Taipei foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.445, a depreciation of 0.107, with transaction volume expanding to $2.831 billion.

The Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.468, a depreciation of 0.12, with a transaction volume of $1.022 billion. Combined, the two major FX markets saw total turnover rise to $3.853 billion, indicating extremely active trading and fierce battles between buyers and sellers.

items.title: 印尼股票市場拋售加劇 並蔓延至債券與印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Stock Market Sell‑Off Intensifies and Spreads to Bonds and Rupiah
paras: 印尼雅加達綜合指數(JCI)持續下挫，周一(19日)盤中一度重挫5.4%，延續上周五崩跌12%的頹勢。此次下跌，主要受到指數編算公司摩根士丹利資本國際(MSCI Inc.)發出潛在降級警告影響。
相關衝擊造成印尼金融市場拋售潮全面擴大，股市陷入近30年來最嚴重暴跌，賣壓並迅速延燒至債券與印尼盾匯市。
MSCI 上周五表示，出於可投資性等疑慮，正考慮將印尼從「新興市場」直接降級至「獨立市場」，此舉遠超今年1月警示降至「邊境市場」的幅度。措手不及的印尼官方已安排於周一與 MSCI 高層會面尋求釐清。
高盛估算，若印尼被完全剔除，可能觸發約56億美元的被動型資金撤出，若富時羅素(FTSE Russell)跟進，恐再面臨27億美元流出風險。2026年截至目前，外資已從印尼股市淨撤出51億美元，創下歷史最大年度外流紀錄。
針對市場崩盤與資金外逃，新加坡東斯銀行(SEB)亞洲策略主管 Eugenia Victorino 指出：「外資正全線撤離印尼股市，債市也感受到熱度。印尼盾走弱正侵蝕實質殖利率，在匯率止穩前，全球資金寧可安全地位於場外觀望。」
PT MNC Sekuritas 分析師 Herditya Wicaksana 表示：「賣壓依然顯著，特別是像大型銀行這類對雅加達綜合指數影響巨大的股票。」
星展集團(DBS Group) 警告，衝擊可能進一步蔓延並緊縮融資條件，推升10年期國債殖利率邁向7.5%，並促使印尼央行再升息50至100個基點。
為遏止跌勢，印尼證券交易所周一緊急調緊單一股票每日最大跌幅限制，由15%縮減至7%，施行至今年底
。企業端也展開自救，富豪 Prajogo Pangestu 旗下三家公司計畫合計買回2.5兆印尼盾(約1.38億美元)庫藏股；金光集團旗下 PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa 也提議買回1兆印尼盾股票。
paras_en: Indonesia’s Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) kept sliding, plunging as much as 5.4% during Monday’s (the 19th) session, extending the 12% crash that began last Friday. The drop was mainly triggered by a potential downgrade warning issued by the index‑calculating firm MSCI Inc.

The fallout sparked a broad sell‑off across Indonesia’s financial markets, with the equity market experiencing its steepest plunge in nearly 30 years and selling pressure quickly spilling over into bonds and the rupiah foreign‑exchange market.

MSCI said on Friday that, due to concerns over investability, it is considering moving Indonesia from the “Emerging Markets” category directly to “Standalone Market,” a step far beyond the warning in January that it might be demoted to a “Frontier Market.” Caught off guard, Indonesian officials have arranged a meeting with senior MSCI officials on Monday to seek clarification.

Goldman Sachs estimates that a full removal of Indonesia could trigger about $5.6 billion of passive‑fund outflows, and if FTSE Russell follows suit, another $2.7 billion could flee. To date in 2026, foreign investors have net‑withdrawn $5.1 billion from Indonesia’s stock market, setting a record for the largest annual outflow.

Commenting on the market crash and capital flight, Eugenia Victorino, head of Asian strategy at Singapore’s SEB, said: “Foreign investors are pulling out of Indonesian equities across the board, and the bond market is feeling the heat. A weaker rupiah is eroding real yields, and until the currency stabilises, global capital would rather stay safely off‑exchange and wait.”
Herditya Wicaksana, an analyst at PT MNC Sekuritas, noted: “Selling pressure remains significant, especially in stocks like large banks that have a huge impact on the Jakarta Composite Index.”

DBS Group warned that the shock could spread further and tighten financing conditions, pushing the 10‑year government bond yield toward 7.5% and prompting the Bank of Indonesia to raise rates by another 50 to 100 basis points.

To curb the decline, the Indonesia Stock Exchange on Monday urgently tightened the daily maximum price‑move limit for individual stocks, cutting it from 15% to 7% effective through the end of the year.

Companies are also taking self‑help measures: billionaire Prajogo Pangestu’s three firms plan to repurchase a total of 2.5 trillion rupiah (about $138 million) of shares, and PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa of the Golden Light Group has proposed buying back 1 trillion rupiah of stock.

items.title: 人工智慧浪潮助推 馬來西亞9月出口額創逾5年新高
items.title_en: AI Wave Boosts Malaysia's September Export Value to Over Five-Year High
paras: 受惠於全球人工智慧(AI)浪潮與資料中心建置帶動的半導體及電子產品需求，馬來西亞今年9月外貿展現強勁成長力道，出口額刷新逾5年來最高紀錄。
根據馬來西亞統計局(DOSM)與投資貿易暨工業部(MITI)公布的最新數據，馬來西亞9月出口額達2,151億令吉(約合450億美元)，年增54.5%，表現遠超出《路透》調查預期的44.6%及《彭博》預估的39.9%。
在進出口同步雙位數成長帶動下，9月總貿易額年增53.7%至3,965億令吉。進口額則年增52.7%至1,814億令吉，高於市場預期的39%，9月貿易順差擴大約65%至337億令吉，高於預期的316億令吉。
統計局資料顯示，進口擴張主要由生產輸入端需求強勁所推升，其中中間財進口大增69.6%至921億令吉，資本財與消費財進口亦分別成長20.9%及18.2%。
從主要出口商品來看，占總出口半數以上的電子與電器產品(E&E)9月出口額年增率高達68%至69.2%，創下單月歷史新高。包含半導體測試儀器在內的光學與科學設備出口額亦同步登頂。
出口市場方面，對台灣出口年增率高達175.2%(成長超過一倍)，對美國出口成長89.9%，對中國出口則成長22.1%。相對地，受棕櫚油出口減少拖累，農業出口年減5.7%。
針對未來外貿展望，馬來西亞投資貿工部在官方聲明中特別警示：「馬來西亞的貿易表現仍面臨主要經濟體貿易政策轉變及地緣政治緊張局勢帶來的不確定性。」
MITI 分析，尤其是中東地區持續的衝突可能打亂全球貿易流動並加劇成本壓力。MITI 表示未來將持續「評估相關發展、加強市場多元化、擴大進入高成長市場，並協助馬來西亞出口商進行調整」，以增強外貿抗風險能力。
paras_en: Benefiting from the global artificial intelligence (AI) wave and the demand for semiconductors and electronic products driven by data‑center construction, Malaysia’s foreign trade showed strong growth in September, with export value reaching a record high not seen in more than five years.

According to the latest data released by Malaysia’s Department of Statistics (DOSM) and the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI), September export value hit RM215.1 billion (about US$45 billion), up 54.5% year‑on‑year, far exceeding Reuters’ forecast of 44.6% and Bloomberg’s estimate of 39.9%.

With both imports and exports posting double‑digit growth, total trade in September rose 53.7% year‑on‑year to RM396.5 billion. Imports increased 52.7% to RM181.4 billion, above the market’s 39% expectation, and the trade surplus widened about 65% to RM33.7 billion, higher than the anticipated RM31.6 billion.

Statistics show that the import expansion was mainly driven by strong demand for production inputs, with intermediate goods imports surging 69.6% to RM92.1 billion, while capital goods and consumer goods imports grew 20.9% and 18.2% respectively.

Looking at major export commodities, electronic and electrical (E&E) products, which account for more than half of total exports, posted a year‑on‑year growth of 68% to RM69.2 billion, setting a new monthly historical high. Exports of optical and scientific equipment, including semiconductor testing instruments, also hit record levels.

In terms of export markets, shipments to Taiwan jumped 175.2% year‑on‑year (more than double), to the United States grew 89.9%, and to China rose 22.1%. Conversely, agricultural exports fell 5.7% year‑on‑year due to a drop in palm‑oil shipments.

Regarding the outlook, MITI warned in an official statement that “Malaysia’s trade performance still faces uncertainty from major economies’ shifting trade policies and heightened geopolitical tensions.”

MITI analysis notes that ongoing conflicts in the Middle East could disrupt global trade flows and increase cost pressures. It said Malaysia will continue to “assess developments, strengthen market diversification, expand entry into high‑growth markets, and help exporters adjust,” to boost the resilience of its foreign trade.

Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell expressed optimism about the resilience of the U.S. economy and said that the investment boom spurred by artificial‑intelligence advances and its spill‑over into other sectors is creating short‑term demand pressure that could push inflation higher. He declined to reveal what actions might be taken at the remaining meetings this year, leaving the dollar under pressure. Meanwhile, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said it is becoming increasingly important to keep core‑inflation near the BOJ’s 2% target, and a Reuters poll shows that rising energy prices from the Middle‑East conflict are gradually passing through to households. Japan’s core CPI for September could exceed the BOJ’s 2% goal for the first time since December. U.S. Treasury Deputy Secretary Erin Browne added that Japan is no longer in a decade‑long deflationary environment, so its exchange‑rate level and monetary policy must adjust. Japanese investors have sold foreign bonds for the fourth consecutive week as of the week ending Oct. 10, continuing the pull‑out from overseas bond markets, which supports the yen and pushed USD/JPY down to a low of 157.67.

Subsequent U.S. official data for September showed industrial production up 0.7% and manufacturing output up 0.3%, while capacity utilization rose to 76.9%. Import and export prices rose 1.1% and 2.2% month‑over‑month, both above expectations, and import prices jumped 8.1% year‑over‑year – the biggest rise since July 2022. The figures indicate that, as the Middle‑East conflict persists, domestic inflation pressure in the United States is intensifying, driving the dollar up to a high of 158.33 against the yen. The market expects resistance for USD/JPY around 158.10‑30 and support around 157.30‑50.
EUR/USD

The IMF noted that France’s short‑term borrowing costs remain manageable, but fiscal‑adjustment pressure could increase, pushing EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1206. The market expects support for the euro around 1.1190‑1.1210 and resistance around 1.1260‑1.1280.

items.title: 台幣逼近32.5元還會貶？外銀看好強勁出口支撐 年底反攻31.5元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Near 32.5 per Dollar – Will It Depreciate Further? Foreign Banks See Strong Export Support, Expect a Rebound to 31.5 by Year‑End
paras: 分析師表示，全球市場對人工智慧（AI）交易的疑慮引發新台幣走弱，卻掩蓋了台灣經濟的基本韌性；穩健的經濟基本面可望支撐新台幣在年底前回升。
儘管新台幣近期承受沉重壓力，華僑銀行與荷蘭國際集團（ING）仍預期，新台幣將分別回升至兌1美元31.60元與31.50元，較目前水準升值約2%。
這些預測的依據，是台灣強勁的經濟成長與經常帳順差。儘管市場對AI股高估值的疑慮持續推動資金外流，短期壓抑匯率，分析師預期，未來幾個月貿易基本面的支撐終將占上風。
三菱日聯銀行（MUFG）亞洲全球市場研究主管Lin Li表示：「創紀錄的貿易順差與AI相關出口，持續為新台幣提供基本支撐。但外資證券投資流出、對外投資，以及美元與新台幣之間龐大的利差，目前正創造美元需求，抵銷這些支撐。」
她預期，新台幣年底前將升至兌1美元31.8元，並在2027年6月底進一步升至30.9元。
出口與順差強勁 外資撤出台股形成拉鋸
受全球先進晶片需求空前強勁帶動，台灣經常帳順差在2025年底達到近700億美元的歷史新高，近幾個月則溫和收窄。同時，政府將全年經濟成長率預測上修至逾10%，台灣可望迎來2010年以來首次雙位數成長。
不過，這些基本面優勢正與外資撤離潮相互拉鋸。外資周四賣超台股新台幣3,026億元（約93億美元），創單日新高，推動新台幣逼近今年以來兌1美元約32.50元的低點。
雖然分析師不認為這個價位是央行必須捍衛的防線，但仍密切關注，視其為央行可接受匯率區間的重要參考。
ING大中華區首席經濟學家宋林表示：「央行將試圖讓新台幣維持相對區間震盪。我不認為存在必須守住的明確防線，但今年以來，31.5至32.5元似乎一直是央行可以接受的區間。」
道富銀行亞太區總體策略師Jiuk Choi認為，央行更可能著重降低匯率波動，而非鎖定特定價位。他表示：「話雖如此，我們認為美元兌新台幣32.4至32.5元是重要區間，因為這是2026年以來的高點。」
油價與利差添壓力 中期仍看升
除了科技業疑慮，台灣作為能源進口國，偏高的原油價格也為新台幣增添壓力。此外，美國10年期公債殖利率較台灣同天期公債高出約300個基點，具吸引力的利差持續支撐美元普遍走強，壓抑區域貨幣表現。
LGT私人銀行外匯與利率專家Trang Le表示：「短期逆風包括外資撤出台股，以及聯準會立場偏鷹帶動美元走強。」
她指出：「即便如此，強勁的出口動能、穩健的對外收支，以及AI驅動的半導體景氣循環，仍使新台幣中期走勢偏向升值。我們預期，匯率波動將是主軸，而非持續走弱。」
科技財報成下一個匯率關鍵
匯市交易員正關注主要半導體製造商的財報，策略師視其為牽動跨境股市資金流向與匯率波動的下一個關鍵因素。台積電周四公布優於預期的營收展望，卻未能完全平息市場對整體AI基礎建設擴張的疑慮。
道富銀行的Choi表示：「接下來公布的全球科技業財報，可能加劇新台幣波動，尤其市場對AI相關資本支出、獲利能力及中國競爭的敏感度已升高。」
他認為，AI交易疑慮仍可能讓新台幣短期進一步走弱，但預期年底前將回升至兌1美元31.80元。
他表示：「我們認為，新台幣是對沖美元走強的最佳貨幣之一，因為資本與經常帳資金流仍然強勁，而且新台幣也是新興市場中波動率最低的貨幣之一。」
paras_en: Analysts say that global concerns over artificial‑intelligence (AI) trading have weakened the New Taiwan dollar, but this masks the underlying resilience of Taiwan’s economy; a solid economic foundation is expected to support a rebound of the currency before year‑end.

Even though the New Taiwan dollar has been under heavy pressure recently, both OCBC and ING forecast that it will recover to about NT$31.60 per US$1 and NT$31.50 per US$1 respectively, roughly a 2% appreciation from current levels.

These forecasts are based on Taiwan’s strong economic growth and current‑account surplus. Although market worries about over‑valued AI stocks continue to drive capital outflows and suppress the exchange rate in the short term, analysts expect the trade fundamentals to ultimately prevail in the coming months.

Lin Li, head of Asian Global Markets Research at MUFG, said: “Record‑high trade surpluses and AI‑related exports continuously provide fundamental support for the New Taiwan dollar. Yet foreign‑security outflows, outbound investment and the huge interest‑rate differential between the dollar and the New Taiwan dollar are currently creating dollar demand that offsets those supports.”
She projects the New Taiwan dollar will rise to NT$31.8 per US$1 by year‑end and further to NT$30.9 by the end of June 2027.
Strong exports and surplus, foreign‑capital pull‑out creates a tug‑of‑war in Taiwan equities

Fueled by unprecedented demand for advanced chips worldwide, Taiwan’s current‑account surplus is set to hit a historic high of nearly US$70 billion by the end of 2025, though it has narrowed modestly in recent months. At the same time, the government has lifted its full‑year growth forecast to above 10%, positioning Taiwan for its first double‑digit expansion since 2010.

However, these fundamental strengths are being contested by a wave of foreign‑capital outflows. On Thursday foreign investors sold NT$3,026 billion (about US$9.3 billion) of Taiwan equities, a single‑day record, pushing the New Taiwan dollar toward this year’s low of roughly NT$32.50 per US$1.
While analysts do not view this level as a hard floor the central bank must defend, they are watching it closely as an important reference for the exchange‑rate band the bank may tolerate.

Song Lin, chief economist for Greater China at ING, said: “The central bank will try to keep the New Taiwan dollar within a relative range. I don’t see a clear floor that must be defended, but since the start of the year the NT$31.5‑NT$32.5 band has seemed acceptable to the central bank.”

Jiuk Choi, global‑strategy head for Asia‑Pacific at State Street, believes the central bank is more likely to focus on reducing volatility rather than anchoring a specific level. He added: “That said, we see NT$32.4‑NT$32.5 per US$1 as a key zone because it marks the high point reached in 2026.”
Oil prices and interest‑rate spreads add pressure; medium‑term outlook still upward

Beyond tech‑sector concerns, Taiwan’s status as an energy‑importing nation means high crude‑oil prices add further pressure on the New Taiwan dollar. In addition, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield is about 300 basis points higher than Taiwan’s comparable bond, and the attractive spread continues to underpin a broadly strong dollar, suppressing regional currencies.
Trang Le, FX and rates specialist at LGT Private Bank, said: “Short‑term headwinds include foreign‑capital outflows from Taiwan equities and a hawkish Fed stance that is bolstering the dollar.”

She noted: “Even so, strong export momentum, solid external balances and an AI‑driven semiconductor cycle still tilt the medium‑term New Taiwan dollar trend toward appreciation. We expect exchange‑rate volatility to be the main driver, not a continued weakening.”
Tech earnings become the next exchange‑rate catalyst

FX traders are watching earnings reports from major semiconductor manufacturers, which strategists see as the next key factor influencing cross‑border equity flows and currency moves. TSMC’s Thursday earnings outlook beat expectations, but did not fully allay market concerns about the broader AI‑infrastructure expansion.

State Street’s Choi said: “The upcoming global tech earnings season could amplify New Taiwan dollar volatility, especially as market sensitivity to AI‑related capex, profitability and competition from China has risen.”
He believes AI‑trading worries could still push the New Taiwan dollar lower in the short term, but expects a rebound to NT$31.80 per US$1 by year‑end.

He added: “We see the New Taiwan dollar as one of the best hedges against a strong dollar because capital and current‑account flows remain robust, and the New Taiwan dollar is also among the least volatile currencies in emerging markets.”
